title: Okay... I have to ask
content: This is all crazy, I'm just now finding any of this but now I NEED to know. For years and years I have been telling my aunt and anyone that would listen that I always feel more at home in my dreams than I do in reality, and I typically remember all of my dreams in great detail and lucid dreamnd I want to point out that I have been dreaming of this universe (aka mall world) for as long as I can remember. (I even have bizarre stories about sharing dreams with others when I was younger with no explanation as to how or why) but this truly disturbed me.... In 2020 (during COVID) I asked my psychology prof at the time what my reoccurring dreams of mall world could mean, he told me it was nothing other than my mind trying to cope with all of my anxiety and lack of control which is why all kinds of stuff was happening, but when I saw the map and heard about the bathrooms, mall, water park, school, school yard, and the nightmare sections I truly feel less alone now. I want to point out that during the "have you dreamt of this man" stuff I never had dreamt of that guy, nor did he ever seem or look familiar, and so it doesn't seem like I am always in tune with everyone so please take this next sentence with a grain of salt, but even in this mall world thread there are a few things I personally have never experienced or seen.. But I HAVE to ask because I've been in this realm for over a decade. FIRST: PLEASE tell me someone else knows what I am talking about.. In this same realm, towards the bottom/end of the mall, there seems to be what looks like a series of hallways and doors, it looks kind of like if someone made a haunted maze out of the halls with red lights and dark areas, creepy carnival music, and even actors, there is even a mirror maze section and even a dark room with a circle on the ground and mirrors around..but if you get past it, you'll end up in a hospital like place. (That kind of looks like a mental hospital or maybe even an er?) SECOND: there is a house in this realm that both my aunt and I have dreamt about for years (not attached to the mall, but it seems like I always end up here if I become too lucid, even if I don't want to.) I have only ever called it "the mansion" essentially, it is this very big elaborate house with many different rooms there's a theater room, a room with mannequins, severally different kitchens, bedrooms,living rooms, etc. There's even fancy looking bathrooms in this house and the farther in this house you go, the more lost you become. And the more random rooms you find. I can never seem to find anyone else here, and when I do feel people near something always tells me I have to hide though I don't know why... But I just know for some reason that for my own safety, I can not be seen THIRD:The water park. For me, the water park always looks the same. It almost looks like it is on top of a mountain view, and you have to drive up the mountain to get to it. There is a hotel for you to stay at and when you get done checking in, there is a pool and kitty pool right outside of the resort, and if you go past that and up a hill there are more elaborate things like water slides, parks, etc. And across from the water park there is what seems to be a neighborhood in a wooded area? FOURTH: THE END OF THE INTERSTATE I have only been to this part twice ever but I never want to go back. Theres a huge wall at the end of one of the interstates... If you crash into it you spawn in this area that looks almost like an abandoned ghost town, but when you walk the streets you only see empty buildings and even though you don't directly see anything you get that same weird clowny/carnival feeling but it feels like a trap place... Like it is still being built to trap innocent souls or something. The last time I was there (3 years ago or so now) a little boy was there.. He looked to be no older than 6-7, frail, pale white, short darker hair, and a stripped shirt. He told me that it was a promise land that they were building where children could be free and play and have fun all of the time.. But I wasn't allowed to see who "they" were, and the boy seemed to get very offended when I asked to leave. FIFTH: The cabin in the woods. Many times I have woken up in this realm with a bunch of other girls I do not know in real life, we are all seemingly kidnapped and kept hostage in the woods in this cabin. Every time I dream of this place, I do eventually break free and run through the woods until I get to the same looking neighborhood that is near the water park. SIXTH: A RANDOM NEIGHBORHOOD WITH A COMPLETELY FENCED OFF BASKETBALL COURT. Allot of my old nightmares used to happen in this section, even ones that I have had that were identical to my aunts. It's a green court with a black fence all the way around it and it is right next to the woods. There is always thorns and such on the other side it isn't wooded area that you can actua6 walk in. I have dreamt of many places already discussed in this thread that I can see, and many I have not personally... But I can not be alone here and I would like even more conformation now that I am finally figuring out other people go here.
